crossRefs.note: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh,
He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.
For though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me,” says the Lord Yahweh.
Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?
For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject…
If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

translations.web: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,
translations.bsb: If I should wash myself with snow and cleanse my hands with lye,
translations.kjv: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;
translations.asv: If I wash myself with snow water, And make my hands never so clean;
